applicableDomain: IHE XDS.b Document Sharing, PIXm/PDQm Cross-Domain Patient Identity & ATNA Security Audit
descriptionAndPurpose: Executes standards-compliant IHE PIXm/PDQm patient cross-referencing without blindly merging organization IDs, registers/retrieves clinical documents via XDS.b, and emits RFC 3881 / IHE ATNA security audit records.
prerequisiteConditions: Configured assigning authority OID and mutual-TLS XDS.b registry/repository peer.
safetyChecks: Never treats distinct organizations' local patient IDs as globally equivalent without explicit PIXm cross-reference.
Every query and retrieval generates mandatory ATNA audit event.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Deprecated XDS.b documents are marked deprecated via lifecycle metadata rather than physically erased.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: IHE ATNA + @ClinicalAudit record every cross-domain lookup, document submission, and retrieval.
completionCriteria: Cross-domain patient mapping resolved, XDS.b transaction completed, and ATNA audit emitted.
